StoryPage.heroIndex: From Palestine, with thread and love
StoryPage.description: Zarkasha is a space that celebrates Palestinian embroidery as a living art; we carry it with us, rediscover it, and give it a place in everyday details.
StoryPage.manifestoTextPart1: We don't just make a beautiful piece;
StoryPage.manifestoTextPart2: we give the thread space to tell
StoryPage.manifestoTextHighlight: about a land, a memory, and a people.
StoryPage.originKicker: When Heritage Becomes Part of Our Day
StoryPage.originLead: We see heritage as a living extension, not a distant image. Therefore, we seek balance between the authenticity of embroidery and the simplicity of the piece that accompanies you today.
StoryPage.originText: At Zarkasha, every idea starts with meaning: a color that recalls a memory, a pattern that carries identity, or a gift we want to say what words cannot. From here, details quietly form to make each piece close to the heart.
